# Archived Early Runtime Fixtures

This directory preserves an early set of runtime and source-rejection cases
for historical reference. Its expected records are incomplete and its source
acceptance assumptions predate the normative Full language contract. Current
conformance checks do not consume this directory.

Use [`../conformance-v1.json`](../conformance-v1.json) and its Full `.cg`
programs for shared execution evidence. Source acceptance is defined by the
Full source specification and its compiler tests; archived rejection cases
must not be treated as current Full rules.
